title: Robotic optics
description: A robotic arm lowers a prism into the beam; a rotating mirror redirects the refracted light onto the receiver.
provenance: The display whitebox is the original generation input. Layout and action are broadly followed; exact frame alignment is not established.

title: Granular flow
description: A gate releases grains through a hopper; a divider splits the flow and two piles accumulate below.
provenance: The display whitebox camera and hopper dimensions were fitted after generation. The original input is retained. Grain detail and local pile shapes still differ.

title: Wind-driven motion
description: The fan speeds up; a model car rolls before a wooden box slides, with different acceleration and terminal speed.
provenance: The display whitebox motion and car occupancy were fitted to generated candidate A after generation. The actual input is V018. Body contours and fan blade phase still differ.

title: Chain-reaction fire control
description: A falling weight releases a ball; dominoes unlock a tipping tank and water flows through a trough to extinguish a fire.
provenance: The display whitebox camera was fitted after a new generation. Its repaired lever-cable-lock mechanism is retained. The generated pin stretches and the tank tips early; local structure and timing still differ.

title: Vertical domino tower
description: Falling dominoes push balls over platform edges, relaying the reaction down three levels to raise a flag.
provenance: The display whitebox is the original input. Ball impact, roll, and fall are retained; generated falls lag and the final flag pole tilts.

title: Pendulum relay
description: Pendulum collisions topple dominoes, release a cart down a ramp, and carry the reaction to a bell.
provenance: The display whitebox is the original input. Cart release and travel lag; final bell contact is not exact.

title: Robot crate puzzle
description: A robot follows a scripted route to push a crate onto a pressure plate, opening the exit gate.
provenance: The display whitebox is the original input. The proxy is replaced with a robot and its route is broadly followed, but the generated gate opens late.
